articles.headline: Day after Hidma encounter, 7 more Maoists killed in Andhra
articles.text:
Sreenivas Janyala Hyderabad, November 19

AT LEAST seven Maoists were killed in Andhra Pradesh on Wednesday morningas the operation that led to the death of Madvi Hidma, one of the most wanted rebel leaders, and five others continued in Alluri Sita-rama Raju district. Additional Director General of Police(ADGP) Mahesh Chandra Laddha said the Maoists were killed in an exchange of fire with the Greyhounds and local police. Four of them were men and three were women. One of the deceased has been identified as bomb specialist Metturu Jogarao from Andhra Pradesh's Srikakulam district. Also known as Babu and Tech Shankar for his ability to build improvised explosive devices, Jogarao was wanted by the National Investigation Agency (NIA). Laddha said while Hidma, his wife Madakam Raje, State Zonal Committee Member Deve, Lakmal, Mallaand Kamlu

were killed during Tuesday morning's exchange of fire, a few Maoists managed toescape.

Ananthakrishnan G New Delhi, November 19

The bench of Chief Justice of India B R Gavai and K Vinod Chandran said provisions already struck down by it in an earlier Ordinance had been reenacted in the 2021 law with minor tweaks.
